name: @resurrect-protocol/contracts
description: Canonical immutable Solidity contracts, ABIs, and Ethereum deployments for Resurrect

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const file of ['abi/ResurrectRegistryV1.json','abi/ResurrectOnchainSite.json','deployments/ethereum-mainnet.json','deployments/ethereum-mainnet-explorer.json']) JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file))"
scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const file of ['abi/ResurrectRegistryV1.json','abi/ResurrectOnchainSite.json','deployments/ethereum-mainnet.json','deployments/ethereum-mainnet-explorer.json']) JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file))"
scripts.test: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const file of ['abi/ResurrectRegistryV1.json','abi/ResurrectOnchainSite.json','deployments/ethereum-mainnet.json','deployments/ethereum-mainnet-explorer.json']) JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file))"
